checks.paper: 3.1 PanoVGGT geometry/camera poses and OOOPS semantics on a Poisson mesh
checks.details: Pano runner binds checksummed video/frame/base-mask bundle, exact model revision/checkpoint and FP32 ERP 2:1 dimensions divisible by14. Frozen pre-review masks are required; no implicit raw segmentation. Stage chain receipts verify dependencies and preserve failed/interrupted output. Existing source_run mode validates source status/generator/artifact/coordinate bindings. Exact external early-semantics producer is separate from release geometry.
checks.limits: Prepared bundle, masks, model assets, coordinates, semantic vocabulary and statistical context must be explicit; arbitrary raw video is not a verified one-click input contract. Original common.py also pins an historical execution server address; portable wrapper must not silently bypass scientific checks. No fresh Pano/OOOPS job was executed by this audit.

checks.details: World points derive from local predicted radial depth plus camera poses, not global_points. Validity requires finite points/depth, positive depth, not masked; configured top exclusion and per-frame depth percentile trimming are applied. Shared-window scales use same-frame same-pixel radial depth ratios; per-pixel shape unchanged. Voxel export records source-pixel correspondence. Final component filtering uses fixed-world-origin 26-neighbour occupied voxels and removes components with count<=configured threshold; ROR/SOR explicitly rejected. Periodic horizontal mask dilation and explicit polygon rules are declared inputs.
checks.original_person_static_filter: early_semantics.dynamic_pixels:30-32 and masks:34-49 require OOOPS dynamic/person support>=.45 and margin>=.15 then2px periodic dilation. filter:60-150 uses point/pixel correspondence, static support>=.35, margin>=.1, >=2 distinct frames and agreement>=.7; dynamic removal plus protected static rescue. It cannot rescue pixels already removed by depth/photographer masks.
checks.caution: These numerical implementation defaults are producer contracts, not all explicit equations in the publication. This optional original-v2 early semantic path is NOT the actual accepted Dorm4/5 raw preparation, which is separately described below. Active artifact reuse does not execute either path anew.

checks.details: Release mesh uses voxel sampling, camera-oriented normals, Poisson depth9 scale1.1 and Taubin5; original v2 adds protected-point fine voxel ratio.5. Original OOOPS semantic votes project retained source correspondences with mesh depth tolerance, exclude dynamic classes, require pixel support.35/margin.1/min2 pixels; fuse defaults agreement.55/mean_support.2/min2 frames. Release Florence aggregate defaults min2 distinct frames/agreement.6 and must not be described as identical OOOPS voting. Geometry correspondence and vocabulary identity are verified for external semantic reuse.

checks.paper: 3.2 same-class connected semantic regions as object targets
checks.details: Per-class canonical shared-vertex connected components; structural/dynamic/non-instance classes and zero-area/statistical surface/residual components excluded as targets. All source observation triangles retained in targets+remainder, separate flat-floor navigation collision proxy. No physical instance identity or physical safety guarantee. checked_profile verifies full profile checksums, arrays/coordinates/capture frame and exact face/class roles. Active mode reuses profile roles; fresh profile producer depends on frozen algorithms and prior context, not old selected viewpoints or old V/Q.
checks.limits: Original prepare_map_profile.py hardcodes release profile template and shared score cache locations. Its original plan input supplies camera height and navigation/grid origins; wrapper must sanitize away old selections. Engineering statistical exclusions and flat-ground assumptions are more specific than publication's short description.

checks.paper: 3.2 each.25s bin maximum Laplacian-variance sharpness frame on original capture path
checks.details: Scans all video frames at1024x512 gray, four192px equatorial tangent views, median interior Laplacian variance. Exact rational PTS bins of.25s choose maximum sharpness, source-frame-index tie break. No front quality/exposure gate. Poses between existing camera anchors use linear translation plus Slerp; no extrapolation, source frames beyond anchor support excluded.
checks.limit: Candidate pose is interpolated from verified existing Pano anchors, not a new independently estimated camera pose for every selected RGB frame. pose_accuracy_unverified/source_image_pose_exact=false remain explicit.

checks.paper: 3.2 q=v*min(1,Omega/Omega0), union spatial visibility with equal-region normalization and importance-weighted maximum object quality
checks.details: Area-proportional, object/region-stratified surface samples; distance/incidence plus BVH rays determine visibility. Active shape-normalized object fraction uses own-mesh self-visible reference denominator. Solid angle=sum(area*incidence/distance^2), q=min(1,fraction)*min(1,solid_angle/.02sr). object_relative_projected_quality=false. Spatial union counted once then per-region observable-area normalized; object coverage is max q over selected cameras, importance-weighted mean. Three independent fresh optimization draws averaged; weights.6/.4. Missing/unobservable targets remain explicit.
checks.limit: Shape-normalized visibility fraction is implementation-specific detail; Monte Carlo sampling and estimated mesh visibility do not prove physical observation or object recognition.

checks.details: Consumes fresh V/Q arrays, no stored final selected set. Multistart greedy gains plus six one-swap passes and top12 two-swap exchange. Both marginal gains must be strictly below limits: spatial .02*initial maximum spatial gain and object .03*attainable object ceiling. Three draws required, mean objective. Active maximum15 views is a declared safety cap, not a fixed plan length;35s deadline may limit search and must be reported.
checks.tests: 10 adapter contract tests passed in main-agent record; this source audit did not execute selection.

checks.paper: 3.3 independent-map structural registration plus regional correction
checks.details: Dynamic vocabulary wall/floor mesh samples, FPFH/RANSAC then similarity ICP and point-to-plane ICP; regional rigid correction. Disjoint sample indices fit/calibration/validation; local bias calibrated separately from residual validation. No old experiment transform or GT change coordinates required. paper_changes.rgb_inputs fits from current capture geometry before current-frame selection; subsequent prepare reuses that same freshly produced fit with geometry hashes.
checks.limit: Historical metric is sampled mesh-surface residual consistency, not GT camera accuracy; it is not a claim about the new current run.

checks.paper: 3.3 global ERP+six faces+up to3 small semantic seed crops, source-RGB SimSaC mean fusion
checks.details: Both current plans are required; no fixed15/current Dorm5/frame/event/coordinate exceptions. Current After anchor count and current selected viewpoint IDs are dynamic. Lowmask selection near anchors prefers masked-fraction bins, bystander gate, semantic diversity/object pixels, sharpness, distance and1s spacing. Frequent person prior>=.1 over all source semantic frames dilate4; extended photographer=capturer|person&prior dilate3. Actual source video frames are decoded at native RGB after selection. Final accepted core has6 faces224px100deg; rotated global ERP1024x512. Semantic components>=64px and angular diameter<=45deg seed max3 ranked crops per source frame, separation>=20deg, same first mesh-hit3D point across opposite frames, FOV clip(2.5*diameter,35,70). Up to2 opposite originals sharing keypoint, max7.5u. Mean=(local+global)/2, threshold strictly>.5, at least2 distinct original-frame evidence. Paired crops received from opposite seeds can make a frame contain more than3 total crop views; seed cap and received views must not be conflated.
checks.limits: Not the shared later22-window test source and not old12-candidate viewer. Actual NN execution must finish and have new pair/probability receipts before labeling this run fresh inference. These tests alone do not prove a complete connected model run.
checks.tests: 8 owned contract tests passed with Open3D runtime library path; masks/ranking/dynamic plans/stage wiring/general verification tested synthetically, not NN accuracy.

checks.details: General verifier reads event viewer-data semantic labels, centers/extents, opposite RGB support and local residuals; adaptive distance, opposite-epoch RGB cancellation, person context, complete-linkage grouping and reflection/window exclusion. No hardcoded event IDs, GT sheet, named evaluation object or coordinate exceptions in execution path. Historical final6 candidates yielded3 groups with all6 retained, not manual deletion; fresh current run is not forced to3.
checks.historical_caveat: REPORT sections3.18/3.19 document rule development on the same24 evaluated cases: grouping-distance change and complete-linkage chosen after errors against known true changes. Thus publication wording that criteria were not tuned to evaluation truth cannot be independently supported; metadata tuned_thresholds:false is not proof of independent development.
checks.table_caveat: Dorm5 historical table baseline6face/global used40+40 originals; crop/combined40+39. It is not a pure same-input ablation. Historical3true0false is numeric evidence, not a guaranteed automatic output of arbitrary new inputs.
